text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementEnvironmentHow the Heat is Messing with Your SleepRestless nights may be the new normal as the globe cooksKFBy Kristen French2:30 PM CDT on August 26, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleLately, nights in San Diego where I live have been hot and sticky. The humidity is so intense that the air clings to my skin and the bedsheets are often damp with sweat. We don’t have air conditioning, so the lazy whirring of fans has become the soundtrack to my restless tossing each night.Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoPowered By 10 Meet the ISS: Moonset Behind Earth Under a Brilliant AuroraShareNextStayIt’s not just me. Heat waves are blazing through much of Southern California, the Southwest, and other parts of the United States, as well as North Africa, the Middle East, and Southern Europe. That means billions of people may be struggling to get a good night’s rest.
